mostWorthwhile.text: Moth's shortest route and the residents' correction made the difference between optimizing distance and meeting actual travel needs concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the survey and trolley before their prerequisite route existed was mildly frustrating; neither attempt explained what was missing.

surprise.text: Inspecting the map automatically produced Moth's stair-dependent shortest route, which revealed why the survey had not been usable yet.

arbitrary.text: The survey's initial unavailability felt somewhat arbitrary until the shortest route appeared; its eventual purpose was clear.

continue.text: Yes. The practical repairs and the way local knowledge corrected Moth's optimization made me curious how the story will address the wider directory problem.
